name: Data Distribution & Scalability
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'wget -q -O yb-sample-apps.jar.part https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-sample-apps/releases/download/v${YB_SAMPLE_APPS_VERSION}/yb-sample-apps.jar && mv yb-sample-apps.jar.part yb-sample-apps.jar && echo "✅ Scale exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-ybdb.sh 3 ysql_num_tablets=-1,ysql_num_shards_per_tserver=2,yb_num_shards_per_tserver=2 && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → scale: ysql-load   (YSQL load generator)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → scale: ycql-load   (YCQL load generator)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → scale-demo           (guided scale-out demo)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → scale-ws             (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → scale: start all    (launch all three at once)"'

tasks.label: scale: ysql-load
tasks.detail: Start YSQL SqlInserts load against the 3-node cluster (init-scale)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for yb-sample-apps.jar and YSQL :5433 on 3 nodes...'; until [ -f yb-sample-apps.jar ] && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB}/5433) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB2}/5433) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB3}/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; java -jar yb-sample-apps.jar --workload SqlInserts --num_reads 15000000 --num_writes 2000000 --num_threads_read 2 --num_threads_write 1 --nodes ${env:HOST_LB}:5433,${env:HOST_LB2}:5433,${env:HOST_LB3}:5433 --password ${env:SECRET} --username ${env:YB_USER}

tasks.label: scale: ycql-load
tasks.detail: Start YCQL CassandraKeyValue load against the 3-node cluster (init-scale)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for yb-sample-apps.jar and YCQL :9042 on 3 nodes...'; until [ -f yb-sample-apps.jar ] && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB}/9042) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB2}/9042) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB3}/9042) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; java -jar yb-sample-apps.jar --workload CassandraKeyValue --num_reads 15000000 --num_writes 2000000 --num_threads_read 3 --num_threads_write 1 --nodes ${env:HOST_LB}:9042,${env:HOST_LB2}:9042,${env:HOST_LB3}:9042 --password ${env:SECRET} --username ${env:YB_USER}

tasks.label: scale-demo
tasks.command: cd init-scale && echo '📈 scale-demo  —  Scale-out demo' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

raw.label: scale: start all
raw.detail: Launch scale: ysql-load, scale: ycql-load and scale-demo together

tasks.label: scale-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual Scale-out commands — ysqlsh, yb-admin (init-scale)
tasks.command: cd init-scale && echo '📈 scale-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual ysqlsh and yb-admin commands here' && exec bash
